tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ gnam chos zhi khro bsam gtan cho ga gtong lugs ni/ hrīḥsngon= spos phyung*/ dmigs med= lan gsum/ skyabs sems yan brgyad/ sku gsum yongs rdzogs thob par shog: rin chen snod du gtor ma ni: gats+tsha= bar/ 'ur sum rdung*/ hūm̐: bla ma'i byin rlabs masuṃ bha ni= mthar/ (Musical notes and signs here) hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: phyi snod= nas/ rak+ṣa hūm̐: (Musical notes and signs here) hūm̐: rgyal ba nas/ tsakra hoḥ (Musical notes and signs here) hūm̐: skye med= nas/ spyan drangs gyur: (Musical notes and signs here) hūm̐: dpe med nas/ sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥ (Musical notes and signs here) hūm̐: sgyu ma nas/ tiṣ+ṭha lhan: (Musical notes and signs here) hūm̐: yid chos nas/ tits+tsha hoḥ (Musical notes and signs here) hūm̐: srid par nas/ ba ling+ta khā hi: 'ur/ (Musical notes and signs here) hūm̐: sku ni nas/ phyag 'tshal bstod: (Musical notes and signs here) sum rdung*/ kun bzang yab yum: spyi dril brgya/ hūm̐: chos dbyings skye med= oṃ āḥhūm̐ swa hā: brgya/ sngags las= satwa= brgya/ las bum nang du= yig brgya nyer gcig badz+ra ar+ghaṃ nas/ chos sku nam mkha'= oṃ āḥ(440)hūm̐: bum lha= e ma hoḥ phyogs bcu= yig brgya nyer gcig hoḥ bde gshegs= nas/ gnyis med grol: (Musical notes and signs here) hūm̐: rang nyid nas/ mthing gar gyur: (Musical notes and signs here) hūm̐: stong gsum nas/ thob par shog: 'ur sum rdung*/ hūm̐: sku gsum nas/ pū dza khā hi/ (Musical notes and signs here) yam bskang gnyis/ bskang rdzas rnams 'ur sum rdung*/ hūm̐: khams dang= nas/ thugs dam bskang: sum rdung*/ hoḥ tshogs kyi= a ka ro= 'ur/ (Musical notes and signs here) oṃ āḥhūm̐: ma mo nas/ khā hiḥ 'ur/ (Musical notes and signs here) tshogs 'khor phul= mdun bum nas/ hrīḥ gnas 'dren/ stong pa'i ngang las= nas/ hūm̐: bdag gi nas/ dkon mchog gsum la=

lan gsum/ tri nṛ yaṃ nas/ sarba bigh+naṃ= gsum/ suṃ bha ni= tshe 'das 'di la= ḍā 'ur/ badz+ra kro dha rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐: ḍā bcad/ ji ltar= 'di ni khrus mchog= de bzhin gshegs= rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs= de dag sku la= srab 'jam= hūm̐: 'di ni= nas/ 'dod chags= 'byung bzhi= kaṃ ka ni= 'og gi ldeb bco brgyad/ kye ma mgon po nas/ sa thob shog: gong ldeb bco brgyad pa' ི sa gzhi= e ma mgon po nas/ skem par shog: yig brgya sogs/ smon lam tshig bzhi yang (441) zung*/ yang ldeb gsum pa'i/ hūm̐: rgyal ba zhi khro'i nas/ bsnyen grangs ci 'grub la/ ldeb bcu gcig pa'i/ sarba sid+dhi hrīḥ gnas 'dren ldeb bcu gsum pa'i/ stong pa'i ngang las nas/ ldeb bcu bdun/ skem par shog: yig brgya yan grangs bsag nub mo dkar gtor/ dgu rdung*/ rtsa brgyud/ 'ur/ thing gcig dgu rdung*/ hūm̐ bh+yo: rnam dag chos dbyings nas/ 'grub par mdzod: (Musical notes and signs here) hūm̐: sngon tshe nas/ chad brtan brtan ma chen mo= mthar spro na gnam chos ltar lhag chen/ 'bring po zhi khro ltar spyi 'gros/ bsdus pa dgongs 'dus ltar 'ur dgu rdung*/ bro 'gugs gsum/ 'ur/ thing*/ dgu rdung*/ hrīḥ chos dbyings= nas/ thal bar rlogs: (Musical notes and signs here) 'ur/ bdag cag mchog sgrub= gong ldeb bcu drug pa'i/ dngos 'byor yid sprul= nas/ phyag 'tshal bstod: bar/ 'og ldeb bcu gnyis pa'i/ hūm̐ hrī: rgyal ba zhi khro'i= nas/ bkra shis shog: shis brjod ci rigs/ rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor= brjod pas grub bo// dge'o//
